description: This file contains unit tests for the Orleans serialization library, specifically testing the PooledBuffer implementation and its interactions with serialization, slicing, and memory management. It includes tests for large buffer handling, slicing correctness across segments, and serialization round-trips.

classes.name: PooledBufferTests
classes.description: A test class containing multiple unit tests for the Orleans PooledBuffer implementation, including buffer slicing, serialization, and boundary crossing scenarios.

classes.name: LargeObject
classes.description: A record struct used in serialization tests, representing a large object with a GUID and an array of GUID pairs, with a static method to generate random instances.

methods.name: LargeBufferRoundTrip
methods.description: Tests writing and reading a large buffer with multiple slices and verifying data integrity.

methods.name: LargeBufferRoundTrip_Single
methods.description: Tests serialization and deserialization of a large buffer as a single unit.

methods.name: LargeBufferRoundTrip_ReaderWriter
methods.description: Tests serialization and reading via a writer and reader abstraction.

methods.name: PooledBuffer_WriteTwice
methods.description: Regression test ensuring that writing the same object twice does not cause issues.

methods.name: PooledBuffer_SerializerRoundTrip
methods.description: Verifies that a PooledBuffer can be serialized and deserialized correctly multiple times.

methods.name: PooledBuffer_SerializerRoundTrip_Embedded
methods.description: Tests serialization of a structure embedding a PooledBuffer.

methods.name: LargeObject.BuildRandom
methods.description: Creates a large object with random GUIDs for testing serialization.

methods.name: PooledBuffer_SliceEnumerators_OffsetCrossSegment_Correctness
methods.description: Tests that enumerators over slices crossing multiple segments produce correct data.

methods.name: PooledBuffer_SliceEnumerators_OffsetAfterFirstSegment_CoversPositionGreaterThanZero
methods.description: Tests enumerators with slices starting after the first segment to ensure correct offset handling.
